description: This header file defines structures, constants, and function prototypes for managing and interacting with commit-graph data in a Git repository, including loading, parsing, writing, and verifying commit graphs.

classes.name: commit_graph
classes.description: Structure representing a commit graph, including data pointers, metadata, and chunk information for efficient commit history management.

methods.name: git_test_write_commit_graph_or_die
methods.description: Test utility to write commit graph or terminate on failure.

methods.name: get_commit_graph_filename
methods.description: Retrieve filename of the commit graph for a given source.

methods.name: get_commit_graph_chain_filename
methods.description: Retrieve filename of the commit graph chain for a given source.

methods.name: open_commit_graph
methods.description: Open a commit graph file and obtain file descriptor and stat info.

methods.name: open_commit_graph_chain
methods.description: Open a commit graph chain file and obtain file descriptor and stat info.

methods.name: parse_commit_in_graph
methods.description: Populate commit struct info from the commit graph if present.

methods.name: repo_find_commit_pos_in_graph
methods.description: Find the position of a commit within the commit graph.

methods.name: lookup_commit_in_graph
methods.description: Lookup a commit in the graph by object ID.

methods.name: load_commit_graph_info
methods.description: Ensure commit info from the buffer and graph are consistent.

methods.name: get_commit_tree_in_graph
methods.description: Retrieve the tree object associated with a commit from the graph.

methods.name: load_commit_graph_one_fd_st
methods.description: Load a commit graph from a file descriptor and stat info.

methods.name: load_commit_graph_chain_fd_st
methods.description: Load a chain of commit graphs from a file descriptor.

methods.name: read_commit_graph_one
methods.description: Read a single commit graph from source.

methods.name: parse_commit_graph
methods.description: Parse a commit graph from memory mapping.

methods.name: generation_numbers_enabled
methods.description: Check if generation numbers are enabled in the repository.

methods.name: corrected_commit_dates_enabled
methods.description: Check if corrected commit dates are enabled.

methods.name: get_bloom_filter_settings
methods.description: Retrieve bloom filter settings for the repository.

methods.name: write_commit_graph_reachable
methods.description: Write a reachable commit graph to disk.

methods.name: write_commit_graph
methods.description: Write a commit graph with specified parameters.

methods.name: verify_commit_graph
methods.description: Verify the integrity of a commit graph.

methods.name: close_commit_graph
methods.description: Close commit graph resources.

methods.name: free_commit_graph
methods.description: Free memory associated with a commit graph.

methods.name: disable_commit_graph
methods.description: Disable the use of commit graph in the repository.

methods.name: commit_graph_generation
methods.description: Get the generation number of a commit from the graph.

methods.name: commit_graph_position
methods.description: Get the position of a commit in the graph.

methods.name: ensure_generations_valid
methods.description: Ensure all reachable commits have valid generation numbers.
